subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a global `cron.defaults.delivery` primary delivery recipient default, and how should it interact with explicit per-job delivery, `last`, `none`, account/thread routing, and `cron.failureDestination`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested fix adds a new privacy-sensitive config surface and permanent scheduled-output routing policy that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Add Focused Cron Delivery Default
options.body: Add `cron.defaults.delivery` with strict precedence, target validation, docs, CLI/UI support, and tests while keeping failure-notification defaults separate.

options.title: Reject New Global Recipient Config
options.body: Keep explicit per-job delivery as the supported path and improve creation UX, preserved route context, or doctor guidance instead of adding another global recipient default.

options.title: Fold Into Broad Output Routing Design
options.body: Treat this as part of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/49078 and defer a narrow config until the broader output-target contract is decided.

recommendation.title: Add Focused Cron Delivery Default
recommendation.body: Add `cron.defaults.delivery` with strict precedence, target validation, docs, CLI/UI support, and tests while keeping failure-notification defaults separate.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current signal from recent cron default work, current blame, and prior triage on this focused tracker.
